title: Open-Source Frontier LLM (GPT-4/o1 Class)

bodyHtml:
What This Is

The point at which open-source language models achieve parity with the best closed-source models (GPT-4, Claude, o1) on standard benchmarks. Reached in 2024–2025 by models like DeepSeek-V3 (671B), Llama-3, Mistral. Democratises access to frontier AI capabilities and disrupts proprietary API economics.. Achieved.

Deployed at commercial scale with multiple competing vendors. Revenue-generating across the industry. Our research database tracks 82 independent sources on this technology.

671B MoE (37B active), 14.8T training tokens. Outperforms GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet on multiple benchmarks. $5.6M training cost vs ~$100M+ for comparable closed models. Multi-token prediction objec

DeepSeek-V3 + Llama-3.1-405B definitively achieved; floor was too low
